name: glass-code-walk
title: Glass Code Walk
description: A camera that scans a frosted-glass code block top to bottom as its lines appear, then pulls back to a centred hold.
useWhen: A code reveal needs camera motion: the frame stays pinned to the line currently appearing, then pulls back so the whole file lands as the payoff.
The snippet is too small to read at full frame and you want it magnified while it appears.
avoidWhen: The code panel should sit still: use glass-code-block.
The point is code producing live UI side by side: use live-code-compilation.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Code
variables.description: Source text, one line per row.

variables.label: Width
variables.description: Window width in pixels on a 1280x720 frame.

variables.label: Height
variables.description: Window height in pixels on a 1280x720 frame.

variables.label: Stagger
variables.description: Frames the camera spends on each line (30 fps).
